mapper.sql: SELECT h_id, w_id, h_title, h_remark, h_create_time, h_org_index, h_org_name, h_time FROM h_handle
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO h_handle
h_id, w_id, h_title, h_remark, h_create_time, h_org_index, h_org_name, h_time,
#{h_id}, #{w_id}, #{h_title}, #{h_remark}, #{h_create_time}, #{h_org_index}, #{h_org_name}, #{h_time},
mapper.select: SELECT h_handle.h_org_name, h_handle.h_create_time, h_waring.w_id, h_waring.device_name, h_waring.alarm_type_name FROM h_handle INNER JOIN h_waring ON h_waring.w_id = h_handle.w_id WHERE h_waring.is_handle = 1 AND h_waring.is_enable = 1 ORDER BY h_create_time DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT h_handle.h_org_name, h_handle.h_create_time,h_waring.w_id, h_waring.device_name, h_waring.alarm_type_name FROM h_handle INNER JOIN h_waring ON h_waring.w_id = h_handle.w_id WHERE h_waring.is_handle = 1 AND h_waring.is_enable = 1 AND h_handle.h_org_index = #{params.org_index} ORDER BY h_create_time DESC LIMIT 10;
